title: Match Data Message Contract
description: Message format for match data submitted from match-scraper to RabbitMQ/Celery workers. This is the canonical contract between the producer (match-scraper) and consumer (celery workers). Field names are the ones on the wire: the argument celery_tasks.match_tasks.process_match_data receives, which is match-scraper's MatchData.model_dump(mode='json').

home_team.description: Home team name. Resolved against teams.name and team_aliases; an unknown name drops the match and is recorded in ingest_failures.

away_team.description: Away team name. Resolved the same way as home_team.

age_group.description: Age group (must match age_groups.name in database). An unknown age group on a tournament message drops the match; on a league message it falls back to age group id 1.

match_type.description: Match type (must match match_types.name, compared without case). Must be 'Tournament' when tournament_id is set.

division.description: Division name (must match divisions.name within the league if provided). Must be omitted or null when tournament_id is set.

division_id.description: Sent by match-scraper. Not read by the worker, which resolves the division by name.

league.description: League name. On a league message it scopes team-alias and division lookups, and an unmapped name degrades to unscoped lookups rather than failing. On a tournament message (tournament_id set) it decides which side's team an exact name means, so when sent it must be the name of an existing league (compared whole, ignoring case): any other value drops the match as one 'league' ingest failure and no team is looked up.

home_score.description: Home team score (null if match not played yet)

away_score.description: Away team score (null if match not played yet)

home_penalty_score.description: Home penalty shootout score. Sent as a pair with away_penalty_score, and only when regulation ended level; anything else is ignored with a warning.

away_penalty_score.description: Away penalty shootout score. Same conditions as home_penalty_score.

match_status.description: Match status. 'tbd' (to be determined) indicates match has been played but score is not yet available.

external_match_id.description: The source system's match id. Stored in matches.match_id (unique) and is what a rescrape upserts on. Required when tournament_id is set.

match_time.description: Match kick-off time in HH:MM format (24-hour, null if TBD), as the venue's local wall-clock time. Read in the home club's timezone (clubs.timezone, else US Eastern) when scheduled_kickoff is absent.

scheduled_kickoff.description: The feed's exact kick-off instant, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Preferred over match_time when present; a value without an offset is ignored.

source.description: Provenance, stored in matches.source on create. Defaults to 'match-scraper' when absent; the live sender writes 'match-scraper-agent'. A rescrape re-files tournament columns on rows carrying either.

tournament_id.description: tournaments.id. Makes this a tournament message: the match is filed on the tournament with a null division. An id that does not exist drops the match and is recorded in ingest_failures as 'invalid'.

competition.description: The feed's own competition name, as sent. Requires tournament_id. Not stored on its own: it namespaces matches.tournament_group (see docs/08-integrations/match-scraper.md, 'Tournament matches'). Runs of inner whitespace are collapsed to one space before it is used.

tournament_group.description: The feed's own group label, as sent — not the stored value. Requires tournament_id. The stored group is only written when tournament_round is sent too, and for group_stage only when this label is; a message missing either leaves the stored group as it is.

tournament_round.description: Round key. Requires tournament_id. Validated for shape only; a key MT does not know is filed and logged with a warning.

tournament_round_order.description: Position within the round. Requires tournament_id.

examples.notes: Match played, score pending from source

celery_task.description: Celery task that processes this message

notes: This schema is the single source of truth for the match message contract
Both match-scraper (producer) and missing-table workers (consumer) must validate against this schema
Version changes require coordination between both repositories
Breaking changes require a new schema version
